enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing slowly. Turning from back to side. Pulling blanket up. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still. Turning to other side. Kicking off blanket. Pulling blanket back. Remaining asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast with Member 1 (joint breakfast, aligned with Member 1's breakfast time)
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs to floor. Stand up. Walk out of Bedroom 2. Walk to Kitchen. Greet Member 1: 'Good morning.' Sit down at table. Pick up bowl. Pour cereal from box. Add milk from carton. Pick up spoon. Scoop cereal. Lift spoon to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Repeat. Pick up glass. Drink juice. Set down glass. Talk to Member 1: 'Did you sleep well?' Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up bowl, spoon, and glass. Walk to sink. Rinse items. Place in dishwasher. Walk back to table. Wipe table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day (Bathroom is free after Member 1 finished at 06:30)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up face wash. Apply to face. Rub. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Pick up comb. Comb hair. Pick up deodorant. Apply. Turn off light. Walk out of Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 2. Open wardrobe. Pick out shirt. Pick out pants. Lay clothes on bed. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to desk. Pick up bag. Open bag. Place laptop inside. Pick up phone. Place phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Place keys in bag. Close bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of Bedroom 2.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Walk to desk. Sit down.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Write report. Make phone calls. Use design software. Print documents. File documents. Attend another meeting. Discuss project with colleague. Review budget. Update spreadsheet. Pack bag. Leave office.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Kitchen. Greet Member 1: 'Hello.' Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Place on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Pick up pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plates. Scoop food onto plates. Pick up plates. Walk to table. Set plates down. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat. Talk to Member 1: 'How was your day?' Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up plates. Walk to sink. Rinse plates. Place in dishwasher. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with Member 1 (joint leisure time)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Living Room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Talk to Member 1: 'This looks interesting.' Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up drink. Take sip. Put down drink. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to Bedroom 2.

Walk to Bedroom 2. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open illustration software. Open project file. Pick up stylus. Draw sketch. Use monitor. Adjust colors. Save file. Open reference image. Draw details. Use keyboard. Type notes. Pick up phone. Check email. Put down phone. Continue drawing. Save file again. Export image. Close software. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed (Bathroom is free after Member 1 finished at 22:30)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up face wash. Apply. Rinse. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Pick up comb. Comb hair. Turn off light. Walk out of Bathroom.

Walk to Bedroom 2. Pick up book from nightstand. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.
Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing. Turning over. Adjusting pillow. Pulling blanket. Remaining asleep.
